# Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commits: `type(scope): summary` with type in feat, fix, hotfix, docs, refactor, ci
- [ ] No AI attribution anywhere in commits, PR title or PR body
- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behaviour
- [ ] Dependency, plugin and image versions are pinned exactly, no `latest` or floating ranges
- [ ] Documentation updated if behaviour, configuration or API changed
- [ ] All written content is in English
